spanish: o jorobado o enano, o nubla en su ojo, o sarna o tiña, o aplastado de testículo.

findings.issue: H1851 is an adjective of thin/small/fine; «enano» resolves that open sense as dwarf stature.
H8400 is a masculine singular noun for an eye blemish/cataract; «nubla» reads as the verb of nublar or as a cloud, so the defect noun is uncertain.

notes: The six או, בְּעֵינוֹ, and singular מְרוֹחַ אָשֶׁךְ match the Spanish list.
